 ## Spec Change Log
 
 ## Review Triage Log
 
+| ID | Verdict | Route | Evidence |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| BH1 | medium | defer | The separately committed typed-query emitter writes the assembly name directly, bypassing the existing namespace resolver; an assembly containing a hyphen produces invalid generated C#. This predates the guarded-write resumption and is outside its intent. |
+| BH2 | medium | defer | The emitter dereferences the first attribute argument without a null guard; Roslyn can expose a null typed constant and abort this generator before other valid declarations emit. This is separately owned generator behavior. |
+| BH3 | medium | defer | The result symbol reaches a generic type argument without rejecting void or unbound generic types; these legal attribute type expressions produce invalid generated source. This is separately owned generator behavior. |
+| BH4 | medium | defer | Public generated methods expose the result type without effective-accessibility checks, so an internal result creates an inconsistent-accessibility compiler error. This is separately owned generator behavior. |
+| BH5 | medium | defer | Collection accepts public static classes, which cannot be emitted as parameter or generic argument types. This is separately owned generator behavior. |
+| BH6 | medium | defer | Collection traverses namespaces but not containing types, so an accessible nested attributed request gets no binding. This is separately owned generator behavior. |
+| BH7 | maybe-false | defer, unverified medium | Referenced discovery intentionally names directly referenced Contracts in its API documentation and filters `.Contracts`; whether `.Requests` is also an authorized enrollment surface needs the owning generator contract/owner decision. If required, those declarations are silently omitted. |
+| BH8 | medium | patch | A disposable parent probe passed a new `.git/proof` log destination through main: it created its report in Git metadata before the genuine missing-repository refusal. Reject metadata paths before creating output. |
+| BH9 | medium | patch | A disposable parent probe used an existing sibling plus `..` to resolve log output inside TMPDIR while the lexical guard passed; the report was created there and would be removed with scratch. Compare resolved containment while preserving original symlink checks. |
+| BH10 | medium | defer | The added correlation OnStarting behavior has no response-starting exception-path assertion. This duplicates VG2's preverified regression gap in separately committed middleware behavior. |
+| EC1 | medium | patch, grouped with BH9 | The edge-case reviewer independently reproduced the same resolved-inside-TMPDIR destination and loss of retained proof artifacts. The parent reproduced the actual main path without substituting business PASS. |
+| VG1 | medium | defer | Preverified: generated-query tests compile and inspect substrings but never invoke the binding; swapping tenant and aggregate arguments remains unobserved. This belongs to the separately committed generator delivery. |
+| VG2 | medium | defer, grouped with BH10 | Preverified: direct middleware tests never start a response, and the real 503 test checks body correlation but not its response header; removing OnStarting leaves these assertions satisfied. This belongs to separately committed middleware behavior. |
+
+All findings were adjudicated individually before grouping. BH9/EC1 share the missing resolved containment check; BH10/VG2 share the missing handled-exception header regression assertion. The two driver fixes are small internal patches for demonstrated destination states. No frozen intent or parent lifecycle change is needed; the complete source-bound proof must be refreshed after patching.
